> 第二章 快活林韩猛（第1页）
聂云龙闻言，神色猛地一震，惊喜道：“原来是青城掌门长春真人！怪不得前辈剑法如此神妙莫测，晚辈今日真是三生有幸！”
原来这长春真人在江湖上威名赫赫，乃是当今武林十大高手之一。长风镖局众人久仰其名，此刻得知救命恩人竟是这位泰山北斗，心中无不肃然起敬。聂云龙连忙躬身道：“前辈，前方不远便有一处酒家，若不嫌弃，还请移步一叙，容我长风镖局略表感激之情！”
聂云凤也在一旁盈盈施礼，诚恳地说道：“是啊，今日全仗前辈仗义出手，否则这趟镖怕是难保，我等性命亦在旦夕之间。”
长春真人抚须一笑，谦逊道：“举手之劳，何足挂齿。既然二位少侠盛情相邀，贫道便恭敬不如从命了。”
聂云龙当即牵过一匹健马请真人骑乘，一行人收拾妥当后继续前行。约莫走了半个时辰，果然见路边挑出一面酒旗，虽只是一间寻常野店，倒也收拾得窗明几净、颇为齐整。聂云龙吩咐店家上了满桌的好酒好菜，摆了两席。主桌上由聂家兄妹与几位核心镖头作陪，其余镖师则围坐另一桌。
众人落座之初，因方才经历了一场恶战，尚有些许疲惫与拘谨。待热腾腾的酒菜上桌，几碗烈酒下肚，气氛顿时热烈起来。席间言语渐多，猜拳行令之声此起彼伏。只听一位狮鼻阔口的粗豪汉子大声嚷道：“他娘的，刚才那三个兔崽子冲上来，老子一刀就劈翻一个！另一个要不是腿脚跑得快，爷爷这一刀下去，他也得去见阎王！”
旁边一位青脸黑须的镖师接口笑道：“赵老哥你还好意思说？当时有个贼人飞身偷袭，眼看一剑就要刺中你，是我眼疾手快替你挡下的。谁知那小子力气倒是不小，你看我这大腿上的伤口，要不是闪得快，今儿个怕是要留个大记号了！”
众人听闻，皆是哄堂大笑，劫后余生的快意溢于言表。
主桌之上，长春真人连饮了聂家兄妹几轮敬酒，面色微红，似是有了几分酒意。他放下酒杯，感慨道：“贫道闭关许久未曾下山，不想今日偶遇几个坏人，竟让贫道动了杀念，实在是罪过。”
聂云龙忙道：“若非前辈及时仗义相助，今日我们长风镖局恐怕要死伤惨重了！”
聂云凤亦是满眼崇拜，赞道：“前辈的剑法当真出神入化，那西北五狼在黑道上凶名赫赫，却连前辈十招都接不住。”
长春真人呵呵一笑，捋须道：“说来也不谦虚，贫道这套‘青城十字闪电剑法’纵横江湖数十载，鲜逢敌手。不过……”说到此处，他话锋一转，眼中闪过一丝落寞，“贫道心中却始终存有一个遗憾。”
“什么遗憾？”聂云凤好奇地问道。
长春真人目光深邃地看着聂云凤，缓缓道：“这套剑法虽仅有三十二招，却是变化万千、深奥难测，非极具悟性之人难以窥其堂奥。贫道门下虽有几个徒弟，奈何天资有限，始终无法领会剑法的真谛。因此，贫道一直遗憾未能寻得一位真正的衣钵传人。”
说到这里，长春真人轻叹一声，随即目光灼灼地看向聂云凤：“方才交手之际，贫道见聂姑娘剑法根基扎实，资质更是上上之选。不知姑娘可愿拜入贫道门下，做我青城剑法的传人？”
聂云凤闻言一怔，一时竟不知如何作答。一旁的聂云龙却是喜出望外，深知这是千载难逢的机缘，连忙轻轻拍了拍妹妹的肩膀，催促道：“云凤，还不快拜见师父！”
聂云凤这才回过神来，心中涌起一阵激动。她当即端起面前的一碗酒，离席半跪在地，恭声道：“徒儿拜见师父！”
长春真人开怀大笑，欣然接过酒碗一饮而尽，随即伸手扶起聂云凤。席间众人见状，纷纷拍手叫好，兴致高涨之下，又痛饮了几大碗。

次日清晨，晨光熹微。聂云凤拜别了兄长聂云龙与镖局的诸位兄弟，随长春真人踏上前往青城山学艺的旅程。兄妹情深，离别之际自是依依不舍，千言万语化作珍重二字，目送二人渐行渐远。

The latest chapter of The Ultimate Sword_Chapter 2 Happy Lin Hanmeng Page 1_The Ants on Mars of The Ultimate Sword_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 2 Happy Lin Hanmeng (Page 1)
When Nie Yunlong heard this, his expression suddenly shook, and he said in surprise: "It turns out to be the master of Qingcheng, Changchun Zhenren! No wonder the senior's swordsmanship is so unpredictable, this junior is really lucky today!"
It turns out that this Changchun master is famous in the world and is one of the top ten martial arts masters today. Everyone in the Changfeng Escort Agency had long respected his name, and now that they learned that the savior was actually Taishan Beidou, they all felt in awe. Nie Yunlong hurriedly bowed and said: "Senior, there is a restaurant not far ahead. If you don't mind, please step aside and let me, Changfeng Escort Agency, express my gratitude!"
Nie Yunfeng also saluted at the side and said sincerely: "Yes, today it all depends on the righteousness of the seniors. Otherwise, this escort may not be saved, and our lives are also at stake."
The Changchun Master stroked his beard and smiled, and said humbly: "It's a small effort, but it's nothing to worry about. Since the two young heroes are so kind to invite you, I would rather obey my orders than to be respectful."
Nie Yunlong immediately took a strong horse and asked the real person to ride it, and the group packed up and continued on their way. After walking for about half an hour, I saw a wine flag picked out on the roadside. Although it was just an ordinary outdoor shop, the windows were clean and tidy. Nie Yunlong ordered the store owner to serve a table full of good wine and food, and set two tables. At the main table were the Nie brothers and sisters and a few core bodyguards, while the other bodyguards sat around another table.
When everyone sat down, they were still a little tired and cautious because they had just experienced a fierce battle. When the hot food and wine were served and several bowls of strong wine were consumed, the atmosphere suddenly became lively. There were more and more words spoken during the dinner, and the sounds of guessing and giving orders came and went one after another. Just listen to a rough man with a lion's nose and a wide mouth shout loudly: "Damn it, those three bastards rushed up just now, and I chopped one of them down with one strike! If the other one hadn't been able to run very fast, Grandpa would have had to go see the King of Hell with just one strike!"
A bodyguard with a green face and a black beard next to him said with a smile: "Brother Zhao, do you have the nerve to say that? At that time, a thief flew up and attacked you. He was about to stab you with a sword, but my quick eyesight and quick hands blocked it for you. Who knew that boy was quite strong? Look at the wound on my thigh. If I hadn't been able to dodge quickly, I would have left a big mark today!"
When everyone heard this, they all burst into laughter, and the joy of surviving the disaster was beyond words.
At the main table, Master Changchun drank several rounds of toasts from the Nie brothers and sisters. His face was slightly red, and he seemed to be a little drunk. He put down his wine glass and said with emotion: "Pindao has been in seclusion for a long time and has not gone down the mountain. I didn't want to meet a few bad guys by chance today, and it actually made Pindao have thoughts of killing. It is really a sin."
Nie Yunlong said hurriedly: "If it hadn't been for the timely help of our seniors, our Changfeng Escort Bureau would have suffered heavy casualties today!"
Nie Yunfeng was also full of admiration and praised: "Senior's swordsmanship is really superb. The Five Wolves of the Northwest are famous in the underworld, but they can't even catch senior's ten moves."
Master Changchun chuckled, stroking his beard and said: "It's not modest to say that. Pindao's 'Qingcheng Cross Lightning Sword Technique' has been in the world for decades and has rarely encountered an opponent. But..." When he said this, he changed the subject, and a trace of loneliness flashed in his eyes, "Pindao always has a regret in his heart."
"What regret?" Nie Yunfeng asked curiously.
Master Changchun looked at Nie Yunfeng with a deep look and said slowly: "Although this set of swordsmanship only has thirty-two moves, it is ever-changing, profound and unpredictable, and it is difficult for people without great understanding to understand its secrets. Although Pindao has several disciples under his sect, they are limited in talent and have never been able to understand the true meaning of swordsmanship. Therefore, Pindao has always regretted that he could not find a true successor."
Having said this, Master Changchun sighed softly, and then looked at Nie Yunfeng with burning eyes: "When we were fighting just now, I saw that Miss Nie has a solid foundation in swordsmanship, and her qualifications are even better. I don't know what she wants.Join Pindao's sect and become the successor of my Qingcheng swordsmanship? "
Nie Yunfeng was startled when he heard this and didn't know how to answer for a moment. Nie Yunlong on the side was overjoyed, knowing that this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, and quickly patted his sister's shoulder gently, urging: "Yunfeng, why don't you meet the master soon! "
Only then did Nie Yunfeng come back to his senses, feeling excited in his heart. She immediately picked up the bowl of wine in front of her, left the table and knelt on the ground, saying respectfully: "Disciple, pay homage to Master! "
Changchun Master laughed heartily, took the wine bowl and drank it down in one gulp, then reached out to help Nie Yunfeng up. When everyone at the banquet saw this, they clapped their hands and applauded. In high spirits, they drank several large bowls.
The next morning, the morning light was dim. Nie Yunfeng bid farewell to his brother Nie Yunlong and the brothers in the escort agency, and embarked on a journey to Qingcheng Mountain to learn skills with Changchun Master. The love between brother and sister is deep, and they were reluctant to leave each other when they parted. Thousands of words turned into the word "treasure", and they watched the two of them drifting apart.
